tools.name: Aline
tools.changelog: Update check and DesignPraise mark added. Same features as 2.1: line angle, custom reference point, Chain Drift with 15 ramps, Bounce Ease-In/Duration, Tangent Tighten.

tools.name: Compensate
tools.changelog: Dockable panel. Drag mode: drag a precomp's out edge to add or remove frames. Fixed frame blending, early-ending layers, start-time offset and time-stretch with trims.

tools.name: Notable
tools.changelog: Several notes, saved automatically. Copy to clipboard. Post as text layer, into the selected text layer, or as a comp or layer marker. A sketch per note; Sketch to Comp keeps proportions, smooths lines and rounds the ends.
